commitments.detail: The quilt will be displayed in the living room during the family gathering.
A light dry cleaning method will be used to ensure the quilt remains in good condition.
The quilt will be mounted using frame mounting to provide stability and support.
An acid-free cloth cover will be used to protect the quilt from dust and other contaminants.
The exhibit will run from October 1st to October 30th, with the opening ceremony on October 1st at 10:00 AM.
